in_sanskrit.name: Arni
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mountain of strength
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Arni एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Arni is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it is believed to mean 'Mountain of strength'. This name is often given to girls in Hindu communities, as it symbolizes the inner strength and resilience of a woman. Arni is also associated with the goddess Parvati, who is known for her strength and compassion.
